children: SignalPlus said it fully compensated 23 affected users, paying a total of $81,897. According to PANews, the payments were completed within 72 hours of the platform detecting unusual activity on November 4.

After the incident, SignalPlus notified partner exchanges and proposed suspending all related API keys. It also paused services on the affected platform and began a security review. While investigating, the team contacted users to verify their cases and process the reimbursements.

SignalPlus said it is strengthening security measures, including raising API access requirements, adding IP allowlist checks, and tightening controls on employee devices and internal access. Services will resume gradually after the system review and upgrades are complete.

title: SignalPlus Fully Compensates 23 Affected Users With $81,897
